tests.description: Outer time guard (20ms) TIGHTER than inner (5s), under the fake clock. The inner block advances the clock past the outer's limit, so the trip carries the OUTER's guardId. The inner guard's try does not own that id and re-throws; the outer's try converts it -> 'outer:timeoutFailure'. Pins guardId routing between nested guards. The real-time sleep() version was flaky on CI (see the runtime issue in the .agency comment).
